description: Strands in-process agent runtime: the five @tool functions, the native ToolResult envelope helpers, the Nova 2 embedding helper, S3 I/O helpers, the AfterToolCallEvent result-collector hook, build_agent(), the adapted system prompt, and the per-tool unit tests with boto3/HTTP mocked. Depends on FEAT-001 (settings) and is independent of FEAT-002's synth (shares config.yml only). Applies LOCKED FIXES 2 (no lazy bootstrap_index; GetIndex NotFound -> fatal ConfigError), 3 (embeddingDimension hint only when expected_dimension non-null; never hardcode 1024), 4 (omit aspect_ratio), and 6 (status slot = success|error only; weather miss nested as result=not_found). Grounded in design.md tool interfaces + Strands verified-facts and the old lambda_function.py (open-meteo logic reused; Titan payloads and the lookup input-image echo removed).
steps: Create <WT>/components/agent/tools/_result.py: ok(**fields) -> {'status':'success','content':[{'json':{'result':'ok', **fields}}]} and err(message, result='error') -> {'status':'error','content':[{'json':{'result':result,'s3_uri':None,'message':message}}]}; plus a not_found(**fields) helper returning status='success' with nested result='not_found' (LOCKED FIX 6 - the Strands status slot is only 'success'|'error').

Create <WT>/components/agent/tools/s3_io.py: parse_s3_uri('s3://b/k') -> (bucket,key) with strict validation; download_bytes(s3, uri) -> bytes; download_b64(s3, uri) -> str; upload_png(s3, bucket, key, data_bytes) setting ContentType='image/png'. Keys are always .png (pinned output_format rule); never derive extension from source filename.

Create <WT>/components/agent/tools/embeddings.py: embed(bedrock_embedding_client, settings, text=None, image_b64=None, purpose) building the Nova 2 [DOC] invoke_model body. LOCKED FIX 3: include 'embeddingDimension' in the body ONLY when settings.expected_embedding_dimension is not None; omit the field entirely otherwise (never hardcode 1024). purpose is 'GENERIC_INDEX' or 'GENERIC_RETRIEVAL' ([DOC], module constants). Read the vector from response embeddings[0].embedding. All [DOC] field names isolated here. Catch ClientError -> raise/return a tool-boundary error per design error-handling.

Create <WT>/components/agent/tools/weather.py: a plain function get_weather_impl(location_name, http=requests) doing open-meteo geocode+forecast (reuse the weather_code_dict and 10s timeout from the old lambda) returning the nested json payload; on geocode miss / non-200 return not_found(description='<default>', temperature_f=None) (LOCKED FIX 6 recoverable). Wrap it as the @tool get_weather(location_name: str) -> dict returning the full envelope.

Create <WT>/components/agent/tools/image_gen.py: plain functions + @tool wrappers for generate_image(prompt, weather=None), inpaint(image_uri, prompt, mask_uri=None, search_prompt=None), outpaint(image_uri, prompt, left=0,right=0,up=0,down=0). generate_image builds the Stability text-to-image [DOC] body with prompt + output_format='png' and OMITS aspect_ratio (LOCKED FIX 4) and omits seed; invokes the image_region client with modelId=settings.text_to_image_model_id (bare core id). inpaint/outpaint download+b64 the source, build the [DOC] bodies (mask image+mask_source or search_prompt for inpaint; left/right/up/down extents for outpaint), and invoke the primary_region client with modelId=settings.inpaint_model_id / settings.outpaint_model_id (the 'us.'-prefixed PROFILE ids, Finding 3b). Decode images[0], upload via s3_io to OutputImages/gen_<uuid>.png or OutputImages/<source-stem>_<uuid>.png. Validate: non-empty prompt; inpaint needs mask_uri or search_prompt; outpaint needs >=1 extent>0. Non-null finish_reasons[0] -> content-filtered error. All [DOC] fields isolated here.

Create <WT>/components/agent/tools/image_lookup.py: @tool image_lookup(input_image_uri=None, input_query=None) -> dict. Require >=1 input else not_found with a message. Embed via embeddings.embed(purpose='GENERIC_RETRIEVAL') on the embedding client, call s3vectors.query_vectors(vectorBucketName, indexName, topK=settings.top_k, queryVector={'float32':vec}, returnMetadata=True, returnDistance=True), take the top hit, return s3_uri from hit metadata. Zero hits -> not_found (s3_uri=None); DO NOT echo the input image (removed legacy behavior). ClientError -> err().

Create <WT>/components/agent/hooks.py: ToolResultCollector(HookProvider) implementing register_hooks(registry) that registry.add_callback(AfterToolCallEvent, cb) where cb appends (event.tool_use['name'], event.result) to a per-instance list; plus a helper latest_ok_s3_uri() scanning newest-first for the first result whose result['content'][0]['json'] has result=='ok' and non-null s3_uri.

Move <WT>/components/bedrock_agent/prompt.py to <WT>/components/agent/prompt.py and adapt the system_prompt string: keep the fashion-only gate and step guidance, RENAME operations to get_weather/generate_image/image_lookup/inpaint/outpaint, REMOVE step 5 (<generated_s3_uri>) and the <answer>/<thinking> tag framing, and instruct the model to fall back to generate_image when image_lookup returns not_found and to state results in plain prose. Delete <WT>/components/bedrock_agent/prompt.py.

Create <WT>/components/agent/agent.py: a cached client factory building bedrock_primary (primary_region), bedrock_embedding (embedding_region), bedrock_image (image_region), s3, s3vectors clients; and build_agent(settings) that (a) LOCKED FIX 2: calls s3vectors.get_index(vectorBucketName=settings.vector_bucket, indexName=settings.vector_index) and raises a fatal ConfigError('run the ingest notebook once to create+populate the index') on NotFound -- NO lazy bootstrap_index path anywhere; (b) constructs BedrockModel(region_name=settings.primary_region, model_id=settings.agent_model_id) and Agent(model=..., tools=[the five @tool fns bound to settings/clients], system_prompt=<adapted prompt>, callback_handler=<trace handler or None>, hooks=[optional]). Tools are thin @tool wrappers over the plain functions taking injected settings/clients so they are unit-testable.

Create <WT>/tests/conftest.py with fixtures: a fake settings object, fake bedrock/s3/s3vectors clients (MagicMock) wired to return canned invoke_model/query_vectors responses, and a monkeypatch for requests in weather tests. Create <WT>/tests/test_weather.py, <WT>/tests/test_image_gen.py (generate_image+inpaint+outpaint), <WT>/tests/test_image_lookup.py, and envelope/hook tests (either in test_image_lookup.py or a new tests/test_envelope.py). Assertions: weather miss returns status='success' + nested result='not_found' (LOCKED FIX 6); generate_image body OMITS aspect_ratio (LOCKED FIX 4) and uses region_name='us-west-2' + bare core modelId; inpaint/outpaint use region_name='us-east-1' + the 'us.'-prefixed modelId (Finding 3b); image_lookup uses queryVector={'float32':vec} + topK=settings.top_k, reads s3_uri from metadata, returns not_found on zero hits, and does NOT echo the input image; embeddings include embeddingDimension only when expected_embedding_dimension is set (LOCKED FIX 3); every tool returns the native {'status','content':[{'json':{...}}]} envelope; ToolResultCollector extracts s3_uri from a representative AfterToolCallEvent-style ToolResult.
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT> && python3 -m pytest -q passes all tool/settings/hook tests with boto3 and HTTP fully mocked (zero real AWS/network, NFR-5, AC-4).
A test asserts the generate_image request body has no 'aspect_ratio' key (LOCKED FIX 4).
A test asserts get_weather returns status=='success' with content[0]['json']['result']=='not_found' on a geocode miss (LOCKED FIX 6).

Tests assert region_name AND modelId per invocation: generate_image=us-west-2+bare core id; embeddings=us-east-1+bare Nova id; inpaint/outpaint=us-east-1+'us.'-prefixed profile ids (AC-8, Finding 3b).
A test asserts embeddings omits 'embeddingDimension' when expected_embedding_dimension is None and includes it when set (LOCKED FIX 3).
cd <WT> && python3 -c 'import components.agent.agent' imports without error (G-import, AC-5).
verification: cd <WT> && python3 -c 'import components.agent.agent, components.agent.tools.weather, components.agent.tools.image_gen, components.agent.tools.image_lookup, components.agent.tools.embeddings, components.agent.hooks, components.agent.prompt; print("import ok")'
findings:
Implemented and verified: python3 -m pytest -q -> 35 passed (all boto3/HTTP mocked, zero real AWS/network); both import-check verification commands print 'import ok'. Strands imports confirmed against installed strands-agents 1.23.0: `from strands import Agent, tool`, `from strands.models import BedrockModel`, `from strands.hooks import AfterToolCallEvent, HookProvider, HookRegistry`. AfterToolCallEvent dataclass fields: agent, selected_tool, tool_use, invocation_state, result, exception, cancel_message.

ENVELOPE HELPERS (components/agent/tools/_result.py): ok(**fields)->{'status':'success','content':[{'json':{'result':'ok',**fields}}]}; not_found(**fields)->status 'success' + nested result 'not_found' (LOCKED FIX 6); err(message, result='error')->{'status':'error','content':[{'json':{'result':result,'s3_uri':None,'message':message}}]}.

TOOL SIGNATURES (plain impl fns take injected clients/settings first; @tool wrappers via make_* factories bind them by closure):
- weather.get_weather_impl(location_name, http=requests)->dict; @tool get_weather(location_name:str)->dict. Module get_weather is the bound tool (no settings/clients needed). 10s timeout; WMO code table reused from legacy lambda.
- embeddings.embed(bedrock_embedding_client, settings, text=None, image_b64=None, purpose=PURPOSE_RETRIEVAL)->list[float]. Module constants PURPOSE_INDEX='GENERIC_INDEX', PURPOSE_RETRIEVAL='GENERIC_RETRIEVAL' ([DOC]). EmbeddingError(Exception) raised on ClientError. LOCKED FIX 3: body singleEmbeddingParams includes 'embeddingDimension' ONLY when settings.expected_embedding_dimension is not None. Reads response embeddings[0].embedding. Body task type SINGLE_EMBEDDING, image format jpeg ([DOC]).
- image_gen.generate_image_impl(bedrock_image, s3, settings, prompt, weather=None); inpaint_impl(bedrock_primary, s3, settings, image_uri, prompt, mask_uri=None, search_prompt=None); outpaint_impl(bedrock_primary, s3, settings, image_uri, prompt, left=0,right=0,up=0,down=0). Factories: make_generate_image(bedrock_image,s3,settings), make_inpaint(bedrock_primary,s3,settings), make_outpaint(bedrock_primary,s3,settings). Pinned _OUTPUT_FORMAT='png'; _MASK_SOURCE='MASK_IMAGE_WHITE' ([DOC]); keys OutputImages/gen_<uuid>.png and OutputImages/<source-stem>_<uuid>.png (stem from basename, extension always .png). LOCKED FIX 4: text-to-image body omits aspect_ratio AND seed. Content filter = non-null finish_reasons[0] -> err.
- image_lookup.image_lookup_impl(bedrock_embedding, s3vectors, s3, settings, input_image_uri=None, input_query=None); factory make_image_lookup(bedrock_embedding,s3vectors,s3,settings). query_vectors(vectorBucketName,indexName,topK=settings.top_k,queryVector={'float32':vec},returnMetadata=True,returnDistance=True); top hit metadata.s3_uri; zero hits -> not_found(s3_uri=None); NO input-image echo (legacy removed); ClientError/EmbeddingError -> err.
- s3_io: parse_s3_uri(uri)->(bucket,key) strict; download_bytes(s3,uri); download_b64(s3,uri); upload_png(s3,bucket,key,data_bytes)->s3_uri (ContentType='image/png').

HOOK (components/agent/hooks.py): class ToolResultCollector(HookProvider). register_hooks(self, registry, **kwargs) adds AfterToolCallEvent callback. Instance attr self.results: list[(tool_name, ToolResult)]. Helper method latest_ok_s3_uri() scans newest-first for first result whose content[0]['json'] has result=='ok' and non-null s3_uri.

agent.py: Clients(settings) builds bedrock_primary/embedding/image + s3 + s3vectors; _build_clients is lru_cache keyed by frozen Settings. build_agent(settings=None, callback_handler=None, hooks=None) applies LOCKED FIX 2 via _assert_index_exists(s3vectors, settings): s3vectors.get_index(vectorBucketName, indexName); ClientError code in {NotFoundException,ResourceNotFoundException,NotFound} -> raise ConfigError('run the ingest notebook once...'); other codes re-raise. NO lazy bootstrap_index anywhere. BedrockModel(region_name=primary_region, model_id=agent_model_id); Agent(model, tools=[get_weather + 4 bound factory tools], system_prompt, callback_handler, hooks). prompt moved to components/agent/prompt.py exporting `system_prompt` (no <answer>/<thinking>/<generated_s3_uri>; renamed to tool names; not_found->generate_image fallback; prose results). Old components/bedrock_agent/prompt.py deleted.

TEST PACKAGE NOTE: tests/ is a package (has __init__.py), so helper classes in tests/conftest.py are imported as `from tests.conftest import RecordingBedrock` (not bare `conftest`). conftest exposes FakeSettings dataclass + fixtures settings/png_b64/image_response/embedding_response/fake_s3 and classes RecordingBedrock/FakeS3. New test files: test_weather.py, test_image_gen.py, test_image_lookup.py (incl. embeddings dimension-hint tests), test_envelope.py (envelope + ToolResultCollector).
